description: This script performs a migration from a legacy MySQL database to a SQLite database using SQLAlchemy ORM models. It handles data transfer for multiple tables such as users, products, categories, orders, and messages, including parsing address and product details, hashing passwords, and preparing for password resets. It supports dry-run and execution modes, and generates reports and CSV files for password resets.

classes.name: MigrationReport
classes.description: A class to track migration actions, failures, and users requiring password resets. It provides methods to log actions, failures, and password resets, and to save a detailed JSON report and CSV of password resets.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] parse_order_address(address_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a legacy address string into a structured address dictionary with fields like line1, city, state, postal_code, country, phone, line2.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] parse_order_products(products_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a concatenated string of products into a list of dictionaries with name, quantity, and unit_price.

methods.name: Decimal cents_to_decimal(cents: int)
methods.description: Converts an integer amount in cents to a Decimal representing dollars.

methods.name: MigrationReport run_migration( mysql_host: str, mysql_port: int, mysql_user: str, mysql_password: str, mysql_db: str, dry_run: bool = True )
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates the migration process, copying data from MySQL to SQLite for various tables, handling password resets, and generating reports.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: CLI entry point that parses arguments and runs the migration process, then saves the report and exits with appropriate status.

methods.name: log_action(self, table: str, action: str, count: int, details: str = "")
log_failure(self, table: str, action: str, error: str, details: str = "")

ctags.name: run_migration
ctags.signature: ( mysql_host: str, mysql_port: int, mysql_user: str, mysql_password: str, mysql_db: str, dry_run: bool = True )
